notes.subject: ברושים
notes.rationale: ברוש is a cypress-like tree; avañeʼẽ has no word for it, so it is rendered 'umi yvyra' (the trees) — JPS also reads 'cypresses' vs KJV 'fir trees'.

notes.subject: ארזי
notes.rationale: cedar rendered 'yvyra guasu' (great tree), the closest avañeʼẽ picture.

notes.subject: saying
notes.rationale: KJV/BSB add 'saying' to introduce the trees' speech; the Hebrew has no verb and the quote flows directly.

notes.subject: שכבת
notes.rationale: שכב used of lying down to sleep/death — mocking euphemism for the tyrant's death, kept as 'rokérire' (since you lay down).

translation: Avei umi yvyra ovyʼa nderehe, Levanon yvyra guasuikuéra: arakaʼe guive nde rokérire, ndaipóri ojupíva ohendy ñanderehe.
